name: MV Script

params.help: Scripts marked with a parameter in parentheses take Amount
params.label: Script

params.help: Passed to scripts that take a parameter; 0 = the script's own default
params.label: Amount

params.help: Frames between keyframes; 0 = one keyframe for the whole clip
params.label: GOP size

steps.name: mosh
steps.script:
# Forced-MV MPEG-2 encode | ffedit script | lossless decode, over pipes (no MPEG-2 temp files).
gop=$GB_P_GOP
[ "$gop" -gt 0 ] || gop=max
args=()
if [ "$GB_P_AMOUNT" -ne 0 ]; then args=(-sp "$GB_P_AMOUNT"); fi
ffgac -hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -i "$GB_IN" -an \
  -mpv_flags +nopimb+forcemv -qscale:v "$GB_P_QSCALE" -g "$gop" -bf 0 -sc_threshold max \
  -vcodec mpeg2video -f rawvideo - \
| ffedit -i - -f mv \
  -s "$FFGLITCH_SCRIPTS/free-for-all/dd-glitch-assist-scriptsv10/instant_damage/$GB_P_SCRIPT" \
  "${args[@]}" -o - \
| ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostdin -loglevel error -f mpegvideo -i - \
  -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact -map_metadata -1 -map_chapters -1 \
  -c:v ffvhuff -y "$GB_OUT"

summary: Forced-MV MPEG-2 encode + one of the deterministic DD-GlitchAssist ffedit scripts from $FFGLITCH_SCRIPTS (pinned in the bundled toolchain).
